_comment: Copy this file somewhere outside the repo (e.g. /opt/durion/alpha/nlti-personas.json), adjust
the usernames to real alpha accounts, and export the referenced secrets in the environment.
NEVER put a password or a JWT in this file — only the NAME of the env var that holds it.
Resolution order per persona: $<tokenEnv> -> $POS_MCP_TOKEN_<expectedRole> -> <tokenEnv> in the
When passwordEnv/tokenEnv are omitted they default to

personas.name: ops-admin
personas.description: Broad-permission operator; drives the admin suite and the write-gate happy path.
personas.probePrompt: What administrative actions can I take from here?

personas.name: technician
personas.description: Shop-floor role. Drives the permission fail-closed probes: must NOT hold the admin or write-target permissions.
personas.probePrompt: What workorders am I assigned today?

personas.name: counter-user
personas.description: Least-privileged chat user; used to show role-layer differentiation in the persona suite.
personas.probePrompt: What can you help me with in my role?
